investigations.name: pulse-hemorrhage
investigations.title: Hemorrhage and resuscitation in the Pulse engine
investigations.description: Three studies on the pulse_hemorrhage and pulse_resuscitation composites, run through the workbench and recorded in each study's runs.db. Their pass criteria are pytest files in each study's tests/ directory, fixed before the canonical runs and after the pilots recorded in workspace/experiments/_runs.yaml.
investigations.question: How does the whole-body Pulse engine respond to a hemorrhage: how does the response scale with bleed severity, does closed-loop fluid resuscitation change it, and does the same bleed behave the same across Pulse's 21 shipped patients?
investigations.hypothesis: Blood loss scales with severity while the baroreflex holds arterial pressure until the bleed is severe; a MAP-targeted infusion preserves blood volume and pressure; and every shipped patient compensates the same way, with smaller patients losing a larger fraction of their blood.
